text:
Just watched Dr. Lisa Su's address to the MIT Class of 2026 — well worth 15 minutes of your day.

One line stuck with me:

"Run toward the hardest problem."

It's the kind of advice that lands at any stage of a career. The hardest problems are where you grow the fastest, build the strongest teams, and create impact that lasts. It's also the mindset that has shaped AMD's bets in AI and high-performance computing for the last decade.

Whether you're a graduating student, a working engineer, or anyone navigating a career inflection point — give this a watch.
